name: draft-write-flow
title: Guide: Draft Write Flow
description: Agent-facing guide for seller draft creation, progressive editing, image upload, category selection, and publish flow.
text:
# Draft Write Flow

TL;DR:
- Before creating a new draft, first check whether the seller already has an unused draft.
- If an unused draft exists, ask the user whether to continue that draft or create a new one.
- Preserve the returned draft id from seller.draftCreate.
- A draft can be created complete in one call or progressively patched over time.
- Image flow is: user.s3PreSign -> external PUT upload -> user.uploadCreate -> attach upload ids to draft or publish call.
- categoryId should usually come from session.categoryCollection and locationId from session.locationAutocomplete.

Draft continuation rule before create:
- Use seller.draftCollection or seller.draftCount with filter.usedAtIsNull=true before seller.draftCreate.
- If no unused draft exists, creating a new draft is fine.
- If an unused draft exists, do not silently create another one. Ask the user whether to continue the existing draft or intentionally create a new draft.
- If the user chooses continuation, use seller.draftFetch and then seller.draftPatch or seller.draftGalleryCreate instead of seller.draftCreate.

Two valid draft creation modes:
- Complete create: use seller.draftCreate with all currently known fields, optional uploadIds, and keep the returned draft id.
- Progressive create + patch: create a minimal draft first, then use seller.draftPatch to fill fields in small batches, like the app does.

Required fields before publish:
- price
- priceType -> zbav://mcp/schema/enum/listing-price
- condition
- age
- restriction -> zbav://mcp/schema/enum/listing-restriction
- locationId -> usually from session.locationAutocomplete
- categoryId -> usually from session.categoryCollection
- expiresAt -> zbav://mcp/schema/enum/listing-expire
- title
- uploadIds with at least one image

Optional but common publish fields:
- delivery -> zbav://mcp/schema/enum/listing-delivery
- warranty -> zbav://mcp/schema/enum/listing-warranty
- description
- pros
- cons
- draftId when publishing from an existing draft

Category and location lookup:
- Use session.categoryCollection to translate seller intent into a stable categoryId.
- Use session.locationAutocomplete to translate a place or address into a stable locationId.

Image upload chain:
- user.s3PreSign prepares one direct upload target.
- The binary file must then be PUT directly to the returned short-lived URL outside MCP tool execution.
- user.uploadCreate registers the returned CDN URL and returns a stable upload id.
- upload ids can be attached either during seller.draftCreate, later through seller.draftGalleryCreate, or at publish time through seller.listingCreate.

Agent rule:
- Never lose the draft id once it is created. It is the stable handle for the whole write flow.
- Never confuse a CDN URL with an upload id. The upload id only exists after user.uploadCreate succeeds.
- Treat existing unused drafts as a continuation opportunity, not as disposable noise.
